items.title: 68429_Walter P. Thomas oral history interview
items.q: And Russ Columbo got to New York before Bing did.

ctx.x: This was around '33 or '34. I don't know if it was before the picture or not, but it was around the same time we made the picture. Because see, Bing Crosby had met this guy Russ Columbo, and Russ Columbo had heard Bing sing. And Russ Columbo got to New York before Bing did. And he got popular. He didn't just get here before he did. He got popular. He got a little "buh-bu-buh-do" going, you know. And Bing Crosby didn't like him. He kind of hated Russ Columbo with a passion. But Bing Crosby made it. He came and…
But I know the first theatre date he had in New York was with...he was on the bill with us -- but he was the extra added attraction. I don't know who played for him.
